name: google-orchestrator
description: Multi-account Google orchestrator — N Gmail mailboxes and N Drives across unrelated domains, behind one API and dashboard.

scripts.db:schema: wrangler d1 execute google-orchestrator --remote --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'"
scripts.db:accounts: wrangler d1 execute google-orchestrator --remote --command "SELECT account_id,email,status,scopes FROM accounts"
